description: Read-only JSON-RPC pass-through for Solana mainnet. Allowed methods: getAccountInfo, getBalance, getTransaction, getSignaturesForAddress (limit <= 100), getTokenAccountsByOwner, getTokenSupply, getSlot, getBlockTime, getLatestBlockhash, getMultipleAccounts (<= 20). Write methods and getProgramAccounts refused. Choose this tool for: Read Solana JSON-RPC mainnet methods with fallback. Close alternatives on this server: rpc_evm (Read multi-chain EVM JSON-RPC with fallback). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

method.description: Solana JSON-RPC read method (e.g. getSlot, getBalance)
